answer: Vote weight should follow unique trade, not cheap keys. Each identity may keep only one living vine of bilateral credit with already-settled peers, and those edges are written into a public atlas that rejects any two names that share a counterparty set or a settlement path. Each epoch a falcon auditor samples invoices, clocks, and routing signatures, then burns colliding clusters. A cloned fleet therefore needs a fresh, unshareable web of counterparties instead of a copied key.
